bio.text: Sara Jacobs is in her third term in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing California's 51st District, which includes much of the City of San Diego and the cities of El Cajon, La Mesa, and Lemon Grove.
Before elected office she worked at the United Nations Department of Peacekeeping Operations, at UNICEF, and at the U.S. State Department, and was founding CEO of the nonprofit Project Connect.
A third-generation San Diegan, she earned a bachelor's degree and a Master of International Affairs from Columbia University.
